facts.business: SK International Export Limited designs, manufactures, and sells scarves, beachwear garments, and sustainable textiles made from recycled fabrics under brands SEHSAA, SandKastle, and Fabrecycle for domestic retail and online marketplaces.
key_risks: Intense competition in global textile market from China, EU, US, India, Bangladesh, Vietnam
Near-term uncertainty from tariff realignment and shifting sourcing patterns
Dependence on competitive costs, compliance credentials, and reliable delivery
Secretarial audit qualification: delayed filing of e-Forms with ROC in two instances
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during the year were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No materially significant transactions with potential conflict of interest. No transactions requiring disclosure under Section 134(3)(h); Form AOC-2 not applicable.
